newsitem.title: GHANA: Hunt Oil unit to extend oil search area off Ghana.
newsitem.headline: Hunt Oil unit to extend oil search area off Ghana.

text.p: Hunt Overseas Exploration Co (Ghana) L.P. is to extend its search for deepwater oil deposits off the coast of Ghana, according to Ghana National Petroleum Corp (GNPC), its partner in the project.
Hunt, GNPC and Ghana's government signed an agreement on February 20 covering a 10,000 sq km (3,861 sq mile) concession off West Ghana. Ghana's new parliament must ratify the deal.
Hunt, granted a 4,300 sq km (1,660 sq mile) concession in the same area in March 1996, has invested $3 million in exploring there so far.
Senior Ghanaian officials say initial results are very encouraging.
Natural gas from Tano Fields and Cape Three Points fields is to fire a 148 MW power plant in West Ghana by August next year.
Hunt Overseas Exploration Co (Ghana) L.P., registered in Delaware, United States, is an affiliate of Hunt Oil Co.
